messages:
casey_cust: Hey team — our SSO started failing right after we rotated our IdP signing cert. Users get a 403 on the ACS callback. Ticket #12345. Logs show missing signature / relaystate blank for a subset of requests. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex_support: Sorry you're hitting this, Casey. Can you paste the SAML debug snippet from our logs (we need the SAML Response payload and the metadata URL you provided)?

casey_cust: Pasting snippets. Metadata URL: https://idp-corp.example.com/metadata.xml

--- log snippet ---
SAML validation error: Signature missing or invalid
Received Assertion with RelayState: ""
Destination mismatch: expected https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs but got https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs/
--- end ---

casey_cust: Also noticed the metadata we uploaded yesterday had a <ds:Signature/> element that looks empty after the cert rotate (just a self-closing tag).

jordan_engineer: Hmm. Two things to check: 1) exact ACS URL match (trailing slash matters for our ACS strict mode), 2) signed metadata actually contains a valid Signature node. If the metadata endpoint or CDN is modifying the XML it could strip the Signature node.

maria_security: @jordan_engineer can you check our metadata fetcher logs? deploy-bot: metadata-sync started for https://idp-corp.example.com/metadata.xml at 1700001250

jordan_engineer: Looking now. Fetcher log: 
```
GET /metadata.xml -> 200 OK
Content-Encoding: gzip
x-amz-meta-sanitized: true
Body (after gunzip): <?xml version="1.0"?>\n<EntitiesDescriptor>...<IDPSSODescriptor>...<KeyDescriptor use="signing">\n  <KeyInfo>...<X509Data>...<X509Certificate>MIIB...==</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>\n</KeyDescriptor>\n<ds:Signature/>\n</IDPSSODescriptor>\n</EntitiesDescriptor>
```
The Signature element is present but empty. Our xmlsec verification fails on that.

alex_support: Did the IdP recently switch to a CDN or WAF that might sanitize XML? That x-amz-meta header on the response looks suspicious (S3 + CloudFront).

casey_cust: We did put metadata behind the CDN for performance. We tested cert rotation but didn't think metadata would be changed.

maria_security: Quick repro: if a proxy unpacks and re-gzips XML and the signing block is at the end, a misconfigured sanitizer can remove the signature block (or rewrite whitespace) breaking canonicalization. Also some CDNs apply an XML sanitizer to remove script tags; misconfigured rules can nuke ds:Signature content.

jordan_engineer: For immediate mitigation: 1) upload the static metadata XML file directly in the Redwood Console (we'll use that until the CDN is fixed), 2) set ACS alias in your IdP to the exact URL we expect (no trailing slash) so Destination check passes.

alex_support: Casey, can you upload the metadata file into the account settings and tell us when done?

casey_cust: Uploaded the metadata file via Console and restarted a few sessions. Trying a login now...

casey_cust: Login succeeded for me, didn't hit the 403. Will ask users to try. :relieved:

deploy-bot: incident-notify: created incident SSO-170000-1: idp metadata signature stripped by CDN sanitizer; assigned to eng-infra and eng-ml.

maria_security: Next steps: eng-infra to whitelist metadata endpoint from any XML sanitization rules, and infra to confirm Content-Encoding passthrough so signature bytes aren't mangled. Also engineering to add a health check to metadata fetcher: verify xmlsec verify returns OK before accepting new metadata.

jordan_engineer: Filed ENG-SSO-402. I will add a temporary heuristic: if fetched metadata contains empty <ds:Signature/> we will fetch the raw object from the origin S3 link (bypass CDN) and try to verify. Not a long-term fix but should reduce blast radius.

casey_cust: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the console-uploaded metadata as a stopgap while we fix the CDN rules. If it helps, our CDN team says they ran an XML sanitizer rule after the cert rotate rollback.

alex_support: Noted. I'll keep this thread open and update when infra confirms changes. Tagging @maria_security for the audit side (we need a timeline of cert rotate -> CDN rule -> incidents).

maria_security: I will pull timestamps and add to the security incident log.

casey_cust: Confirmed with two power users — SSO now working. Leaving this open until CDL/CND fixes are pushed. Thanks for the quick workaround. :thumbsup:
